caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a high back composed of three horizontal slats, each with a gently curved shape. The top of the chair back features two finials, one on each post, that are rounded and spindle-shaped. The chair’s frame, including the legs, slats, and supporting stretchers, is colored a warm light brown, resembling polished wood. The seat is flat and appears to be woven from a gray material, contrasting with the wooden frame. The chair casts a faint shadow on the neutral, light-colored background, which is otherwise plain and unadorned.
title: Shaker Side Chair
